messages:
alex: @maya heads-up — ACME (acct acme-123) reports objects from our legacy export still showing up in search after we returned 204 on delete. ticket CUST-9087. Customer on legal hold request, panicking. :grimacing:

maya: can you paste the exact API call and a minimal repro? which index/search?

alex: they used DELETE /v1/objects/embedded?id=sh_9f8e7 -> 204. then ran a search against /v1/search with filter `source:legacy-export` and the same id was returned. Said they waited ~30m.

maya: ok. did they use cust-managed retention or default? any retention override?

alex: default retention for that org until last week. they switched to custom retention (shorter TTL) and we ran a retention-policy migration on 2026-03-01 11:45 UTC. customer says objects should have been tombstoned and removed.

retain-bot: Automated alert: retention-policy-change applied to org acme-123 at 2026-03-01T11:45:12Z. Affected objects: ~42,000. Indexer backlog detected: +31k items pending purge.

ops-sre: looking at delete pipeline logs. For acme-123 I see delete jobs created at 2026-03-01T12:05:23Z (job_id=job-0a3f). Tombstone writes to storage at 2026-03-01T12:20:11Z but indexer ack for ~7k objects failed with KMS decrypt error: "KMS_KEY_NOT_FOUND". Backfill retried, queued.

liam: that KMS error matches the key rotation we did for legacy-exports KMS key on 2026-03-01T12:18Z. Rotation should be transparent but legacy export objects used old envelope metadata. I'm pulling HSM/KMS logs now. ETA ~1h.

maya: we need a mitigation path for the customer asap. Options: (1) expedite index rebuild for acme-123 (risky, heavy I/O), (2) re-encrypt tombstone metadata with new key and reprocess, (3) surface temporary search filter to hide legacy-export results for that org. Thoughts?

ops-sre: short-term: add a tenant-level search override: deny results with `source:legacy-export AND org:acme-123` until purge completes. Low risk, applied at query layer. Medium-term: reprocess tombstone metadata after KMS fix.

jenna-legal: place a legal hold flag on acme-123 until we can provide a full audit of deletion events + timeline. We'll need audit logs for 90 days and confirmation of which objects were attempted deleted vs actually purged. Do not perform any irreversible purge until legal confirms.

liam: pulled HSM trace: key rotation produced a temporary key alias mismatch for objects with envelope_version=1. I can generate a one-time decrypt pass that will allow the tombstone re-encryption. Need ops-sre to coordinate and a short maintenance window to run a reprocess job.

ops-sre: agree. I'll schedule a controlled re-encrypt + index re-ingest for the affected job-0a3f subset. Plan: 1) disable query-level show (apply search override), 2) run decrypt+re-encrypt with new key on tombstone metadata for batch subset (throttle), 3) requeue indexer for those IDs, 4) monitor until index clears. ETA 3-4 hours after liam gives the pass.

maya: assigning this to priority. i'm messaging the customer to acknowledge and provide temporary workaround (query hide) and ETA.

alex: pasted minimal repro and logs from customer, including curl snippets:
```
DELETE https://api.redwood.com/v1/objects?id=sh_9f8e7
Authorization: Bearer <token>
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content

# then
POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/search
body: {"q":"id:sh_9f8e7 AND source:legacy-export"}
# returns object metadata
```

maya: thanks. i'll add ops runbook link: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/retention-kms-rotation (internal). Also creating escalation ticket ESC-6212 for on-call KMS + infra to track.

jenna-legal: also need an export of the audit trails: actions.delete, actions.tombstone_write, actions.index_ack for acme-123 between 2026-03-01T11:30 and 2026-03-01T13:00. Please attach to CUST-9087.

liam: attaching HSM trace id hsm-77f2 and grant token. ops-sre, please confirm you have the re-encrypt pass and can start when ready.

ops-sre: got the pass. starting with a small subset of 500 objects to validate. applying search hide now. will post progress every 30m. :eyes: 

maya: i've messaged customer: "We've applied a temporary search filter to prevent legacy-export results for your org while we resolve. We're not deleting anything else; legal hold is noted. Tech ETA 4h, will update in 30m."

alex: thanks. keeping customer thread open. will attach all logs to CUST-9087 and ESC-6212.

retain-bot: Job update: indexer backlog for acme-123 reduced from 31k -> 21k after first batch.

ops-sre: first 500 batch completed, index acked. KMS re-encrypt flow looks clean. proceeding with next batches. next ETA 2h to finish remaining.

jenna-legal: received preliminary audit export, looks good. hold remains until final confirmation.

maya: summary/action items for thread: 1) ops-sre apply search override (done), 2) liam provide HSM passtoken (done), 3) ops-sre run re-encrypt+reindex (in progress), 4) legal hold & audit export (in progress). i'll follow up to close CUST-9087 after final verification. :thumbsup:
